summary: Iteration 13 review of MG-VMS AI Events / motion / segment correlation. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed against /api/events, /api/recordings/timeline, /api/plates, /api/cameras, /api/dashboard/stats. Frontend: /events page renders 32 real event cards with data-URI thumbnails, types (Personne/Vélo/Voiture/Mouvement), confidence %, camera name, timestamps (fr-FR); Voiture cards show vehicle_color (e.g. 'Gris'), Mouvement cards show motion_pct (e.g. 3.09%, 5.19%, 5.96%). Type filter 'Personne' correctly filters to 15 cards all typed Personne. /recordings with demo-cam-002 selected: Événements stat=25, 29 segments listed with mode labels 'CONTINU' and 'DÉTECTION IA', timeline shows green (AI) colored bars, clicking a segment loads /api/recordings/<id>.mp4 into <video data-testid=rec-video>. Regression: /live, /anpr, dashboard OK.
